scripts.title: Spozi hub
scripts.author: Unk0wn_scr1pter
scripts.summary: Shows placeholder notifications. No actual ESP is implemented. Settings tab: Purple theme option. Red theme option. Reset settings. Close hub. Minimize: shrinks the menu. Restores speed and jump after respawning.
scripts.code:
--========================================================
-- SPOZI HUB V2.0
-- SINGLE LOCAL SCRIPT
-- For your own Roblox experience
--========================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- CONFIGURATION
local Config = {
    Speed = 28,
    Jump = 50,
    FlySpeed = 50,
    Theme = Color3.fromRGB(110, 65, 255)
}

local flying = false
local minimized = false
local noclip = false
local currentTab = "Movement"
local savedPosition = nil
local connections = {}

-- CLEANUP OLD GUI
local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("SpoziHub")
if old then old:Destroy() end

--========================================================
-- GUI HELPERS
--========================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "SpoziHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function corner(object, radius)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    c.Parent = object
    return c
end

local function stroke(object, color, thickness)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = color
    s.Thickness = thickness or 1
    s.Parent = object
    return s
end

local function tween(object, properties, duration)
    local t = TweenService:Create(
        object,
        TweenInfo.new(duration or 0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint),
        properties
    )
    t:Play()
    return t
end

local function createLabel(parent, text, size, position, color)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = size
    label.Position = position
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Parent = parent
    return label
end

local function notify(title, message)
    local box = Instance.new("Frame")
    box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 75)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(1, 280, 0, 25)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17,17,27)
    box.Parent = gui
    box.ZIndex = 20

    corner(box, 12)
    stroke(box, Config.Theme, 2)

    createLabel(
        box, title,
        UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.35,0),
        UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.08),
        Config.Theme
    ).ZIndex = 21

    createLabel(
        box, message,
        UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.3,0),
        UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.52),
        Color3.new(1,1,1)
    ).ZIndex = 21

    tween(box, {
        Position = UDim2.new(1,-275,0,25)
    },0.5)

    task.delay(3,function()
        if box.Parent then
            tween(box,{
                Position=UDim2.new(1,280,0,25)
            },0.4)
            task.wait(0.5)
            box:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- LOADING SCREEN
--========================================================

local loading = Instance.new("Frame")
loading.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
loading.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5,5,12)
loading.Parent = gui

local loadingCard = Instance.new("Frame")
loadingCard.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
loadingCard.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
loadingCard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(330,190)
loadingCard.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(17,17,28)
loadingCard.Parent = loading

corner(loadingCard,18)
stroke(loadingCard,Config.Theme,2)

createLabel(
    loadingCard,
    "⚡ SPOZI HUB",
    UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.25,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.12),
    Config.Theme
)

local loadingStatus = createLabel(
    loadingCard,
    "Initializing...",
    UDim2.new(0.9,0,0.15,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.43),
    Color3.new(1,1,1)
)

local barBack = Instance.new("Frame")
barBack.Size = UDim2.new(0.8,0,0,9)
barBack.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.1,0.72)
barBack.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,55)
barBack.Parent = loadingCard
corner(barBack,10)

local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,1)
bar.BackgroundColor3 = Config.Theme
bar.Parent = barBack
corner(bar,10)

local steps = {
    {"Loading interface...",0.2},
    {"Preparing movement...",0.45},
    {"Loading settings...",0.7},
    {"Almost ready...",1}
}

for _,step in ipairs(steps) do
    loadingStatus.Text = step[1]
    tween(bar,{Size=UDim2.fromScale(step[2],1)},0.6)
    task.wait(0.65)
end

--========================================================
-- MAIN WINDOW
--========================================================

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5,0.5)
main.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360,400)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12,12,20)
main.Visible = false
main.Parent = gui

corner(main,16)
stroke(main,Config.Theme,2)

local header = Instance.new("Frame")
header.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,55)
header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,18,45)
header.Parent = main
corner(header,14)

createLabel(
    header,
    "⚡ SPOZI HUB",
    UDim2.new(0.7,0,0.65,0),
    UDim2.fromScale(0.05,0.15),
    Config.Theme
)

local minimizeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeButton.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(35,35)
minimizeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1,-45,0,10)
minimizeButton.Text = "—"
minimizeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
minimizeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55,40,85)
minimizeButton.Parent = header
corner(minimizeButton,8)

--========================================================
-- DRAG SYSTEM
--========================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = main.Position
    end
end)

UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

--========================================================
-- CONTENT AREA
--========================================================

local content = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,110)
content.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,1,-120)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.BorderSizePixel = 0
content.ScrollBarThickness = 3
content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
content.Parent = main

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,10)
layout.Parent = content

layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    content.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(
        0,0,0,layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 15
    )
end)

local function clearContent()
    for _,item in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
        if item:IsA("GuiObject") and item ~= layout then
            item:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function button(text, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,42)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,25,45)
    b.Text = text
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.Parent = content
    corner(b,9)
    stroke(b,Config.Theme,1)

    b.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return b
end

local function textBox(placeholder, defaultValue)
    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.new(1,-5,0,42)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25,25,38)
    box.PlaceholderText = placeholder
    box.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    box.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 14
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = content
    corner(box,9)
    stroke(box,Config.Theme,1)
    return box
end

--========================================================
-- CHARACTER HELPERS
--========================================================

local function getCharacter()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    return character, humanoid
end

--========================================================
-- MOVEMENT TAB
--========================================================

local function movementTab()
    clearContent()

    button("SPEED: "..Config.Speed,function()
        local box = textBox("Enter speed",Config.Speed)

        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if not enter then return end

            local value = tonumber(box.Text)
            if not value then
                notify("ERROR","Enter a valid number")
                return
            end

            Config.Speed = math.clamp(value,0,100)

            local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Speed
            end

            notify("SPEED UPDATED",tostring(Config.Speed))
        end)
    end)

    button("JUMP POWER: "..Config.Jump,function()
        local box = textBox("Enter jump power",Config.Jump)

        box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
            if not enter then return end

            local value = tonumber(box.Text)
            if not value then return end

            Config.Jump = math.clamp(value,0,150)

            local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
            if humanoid then
                humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
                humanoid.JumpPower = Config.Jump
            end

            notify("JUMP UPDATED",tostring(Config.Jump))
        end)
    end)

    button("FLY: "..(flying and "ON" or "OFF"),function()
        flying = not flying
        notify("FLIGHT",flying and "Enabled" or "Disabled")
        movementTab()
    end)

    button("SAVE POSITION",function()
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            savedPosition = root.CFrame
            notify("POSITION SAVED","Location stored")
        end
    end)

    button("RETURN TO SAVED POSITION",function()
        local character = player.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if root and savedPosition then
            root.CFrame = savedPosition
            notify("TELEPORT","Returned to saved location")
        else
            notify("ERROR","No saved location")
        end
    end)

    button("RESET CHARACTER",function()
        local _,humanoid = getCharacter()
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.Health = 0
        end
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- VISUALS TAB
--========================================================

local function visualsTab()
    clearContent()

    button("SHOW NPC NAMES",function()
        notify("VISUALS","Use your own game's NPC display system")
    end)

    button("SHOW OBJECT NAMES",function()
        notify("VISUALS","Object visualization selected")
    end)

    button("REMOVE VISUALS",function()
        notify("VISUALS","No external visualizers active")
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- SETTINGS TAB
--========================================================

local function settingsTab()
    clearContent()

    button("PURPLE THEME",function()
        Config.Theme = Color3.fromRGB(110,65,255)
        notify("THEME","Purple selected")
    end)

    button("RED THEME",function()
        Config.Theme = Color3.fromRGB(255,45,65)
        notify("THEME","Red selected")
    end)

    button("RESET SETTINGS",function()
        Config.Speed = 28
        Config.Jump = 50
        flying = false
        notify("SETTINGS","Defaults restored")
    end)

    button("CLOSE HUB",function()
        gui:Destroy()
    end)
end

--========================================================
-- TAB NAVIGATION
--========================================================

local tabs = Instance.new("Frame")
tabs.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,65)
tabs.Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,38)
tabs.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tabs.Parent = main

local function createTab(name,x,callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1/3,-5,1,0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(x,0,0,0)
    b.Text = name
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35,25,55)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 12
    b.Parent = tabs
    corner(b,7)

    b.Activated:Connect(callback)
end

createTab("MOVEMENT",0,movementTab)
createTab("VISUALS",1/3,visualsTab)
createTab("SETTINGS",2/3,settingsTab)

--========================================================
-- FLY CONTROLLER
--========================================================

local vertical = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not flying then return end

    local character,humanoid = getCharacter()
    if not character then return end

    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end

    local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
    local y = 0

    if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
        y = 1
    elseif UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
        y = -1
    end

    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =
        move * Config.FlySpeed + Vector3.new(0,y*Config.FlySpeed,0)
end)

--========================================================
-- RESPAWN SUPPORT
--========================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    task.wait(0.25)

    humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Speed
    humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
    humanoid.JumpPower = Config.Jump

    notify("SPOZI HUB","Character reloaded")
end)

--========================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--========================================================

minimizeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized

    content.Visible = not minimized
    tabs.Visible = not minimized

    main.Size = minimized
        and UDim2.fromOffset(360,55)
        or UDim2.fromOffset(360,400)
end)

--========================================================
-- START
--========================================================

movementTab()

task.wait(0.5)

tween(loadingCard,{
    Size=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0)
},0.4)

task.wait(0.4)

loading:Destroy()
main.Visible = true

notify("SPOZI HUB","Successfully loaded!")

print("[SPOZI HUB] Version 2.0 loaded")

scripts.author: NEONSCRIPTZ
scripts.summary: a south hell script with cartman esp noclip godmode and so on..
scripts.code:
-- NEON HUB - COMPLETE SINGLE LOCALSCRIPT
-- Place in StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts
-- For your own Roblox Studio experience

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local settings = {
    CartmanESP = false,
    CrankESP = false,
    LockerESP = false,
    Noclip = false,
    SafeHide = false,
    Fullbright = false,
    SpeedHack = false
}

local highlights = {}
local nameTags = {}
local originalCollision = {}
local originalSpawn
local lastHide = 0
local speedConnection

local HIDE_DISTANCE = 20
local TELEPORT_COOLDOWN = 2
local SPEED = 50

-- SAVE ORIGINAL SPAWN
local function saveSpawn(character)
    local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

    if root and not originalSpawn then
        originalSpawn = root.CFrame
    end
end

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(saveSpawn, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
    task.wait(0.5)

    if not originalSpawn then
        saveSpawn(character)
    end

    table.clear(originalCollision)

    if settings.SpeedHack then
        task.wait(0.5)
        setSpeedHack(true)
    end
end)

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "NeonHub"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 465)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.5, -232)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true
frame.Parent = gui

Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 35, 35)
title.Text = "NEON HUB"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame

Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

-- BUTTON CREATOR
local function makeButton(label, y, setting, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 38)
    button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, y)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
    button.TextSize = 14
    button.Text = label .. ": OFF"
    button.Parent = frame

    Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)

    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        settings[setting] = not settings[setting]

        button.Text = label .. (settings[setting] and ": ON" or ": OFF")

        button.BackgroundColor3 = settings[setting]
            and Color3.fromRGB(130, 40, 40)
            or Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)

        if callback then
            callback(settings[setting])
        end
    end)
end

-- MATCHING HELPER
local function matches(object, words)
    local name = string.lower(object.Name)

    for _, word in ipairs(words) do
        if string.find(name, word, 1, true) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end

-- CARTMAN DETECTION
local function isCartmanCandidate(model)
    if not model:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
        return false
    end

    if string.find(string.lower(model.Name), "cartman", 1, true) then
        return true
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("Script") or descendant:IsA("LocalScript") then
            local scriptName = string.lower(descendant.Name)

            if scriptName == "cartman"
                or string.sub(scriptName, -1) == "n" then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function findCartmanModel()
    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Model") and isCartmanCandidate(object) then
            return object
        end
    end

    return nil
end

-- HIGHLIGHTS
local function addHighlight(object, color)
    if highlights[object] then return end

    if not (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart")) then
        return
    end

    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Adornee = object
    highlight.FillColor = color
    highlight.OutlineColor = color
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.55
    highlight.Parent = gui

    highlights[object] = highlight
end

local function removeHighlight(object)
    if highlights[object] then
        highlights[object]:Destroy()
        highlights[object] = nil
    end
end

-- NAME TAGS
local function addNameTag(model, text)
    if nameTags[model] then return end

    local adornee = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
        or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not adornee or not adornee:IsA("BasePart") then
        return
    end

    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "NeonHubNameTag"
    billboard.Adornee = adornee
    billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 35)
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.Parent = adornee

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextScaled = true
    label.Parent = billboard

    nameTags[model] = billboard
end

local function removeNameTag(model)
    if nameTags[model] then
        nameTags[model]:Destroy()
        nameTags[model] = nil
    end
end

-- ESP SCANNER
local function scanESP()
    local cartman = findCartmanModel()

    if cartman and settings.CartmanESP then
        addHighlight(cartman, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
        addNameTag(cartman, "FATTIE")
    elseif cartman then
        removeHighlight(cartman)
        removeNameTag(cartman)
    end

    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if settings.CrankESP
            and matches(object, {"door crank", "doorcrank", "crank"}) then

            addHighlight(object, Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 255))

        elseif settings.LockerESP and matches(object, {"locker"}) then

            addHighlight(object, Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 0))
        end
    end

    -- CLEAN UP UNUSED HIGHLIGHTS
    for object in pairs(highlights) do
        local keep = object:IsDescendantOf(workspace)

        if keep then
            local isCartman = cartman and object == cartman

            local isCrank = settings.CrankESP
                and matches(object, {"door crank", "doorcrank", "crank"})

            local isLocker = settings.LockerESP
                and matches(object, {"locker"})

            keep = (settings.CartmanESP and isCartman)
                or isCrank
                or isLocker
        end

        if not keep then
            removeHighlight(object)
        end
    end

    for model in pairs(nameTags) do
        if not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
            or not settings.CartmanESP
            or model ~= cartman then
            removeNameTag(model)
        end
    end
end

-- NOCLIP
local function setNoclip(enabled)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end

    if enabled then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if originalCollision[part] == nil then
                    originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
                end

                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    else
        for part, oldValue in pairs(originalCollision) do
            if part.Parent then
                part.CanCollide = oldValue
            end
        end

        table.clear(originalCollision)
    end
end

-- FULLBRIGHT
local originalLighting = {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
}

local function setFullbright(enabled)
    if enabled then
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
        Lighting.ClockTime = 14
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    else
        for property, value in pairs(originalLighting) do
            Lighting[property] = value
        end
    end
end

-- SPEED HACK: 50 VELOCITY MODE
function setSpeedHack(enabled)
    if speedConnection then
        speedConnection:Disconnect()
        speedConnection = nil
    end

    if not enabled then return end

    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not humanoid or not root then return end

    speedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not root.Parent or not humanoid.Parent then return end

        local direction = humanoid.MoveDirection

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity

            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                direction.X * SPEED,
                velocity.Y,
                direction.Z * SPEED
            )
        end
    end)
end

-- BUTTONS
makeButton("Cartman ESP", 55, "CartmanESP")
makeButton("Door Crank ESP", 100, "CrankESP")
makeButton("Locker ESP", 145, "LockerESP")
makeButton("Noclip", 190, "Noclip", setNoclip)
makeButton("Safe Hide Cartman", 235, "SafeHide")
makeButton("Fullbright", 280, "Fullbright", setFullbright)
makeButton("Speed Hack (50)", 325, "SpeedHack", setSpeedHack)

-- MAIN LOOP
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local character = player.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if settings.Noclip and character then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if originalCollision[part] == nil then
                    originalCollision[part] = part.CanCollide
                end

                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end

    if not root or not originalSpawn then
        return
    end

    -- CARTMAN SAFE HIDE: 20 STUDS
    if settings.SafeHide
        and os.clock() - lastHide >= TELEPORT_COOLDOWN then

        local cartman = findCartmanModel()
        local cartmanRoot = cartman
            and cartman:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if cartmanRoot
            and (root.Position - cartmanRoot.Position).Magnitude <= HIDE_DISTANCE then

            lastHide = os.clock()
            character:PivotTo(originalSpawn + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end
end)

-- ESP REFRESH
task.spawn(function()
    while gui.Parent do
        scanESP()
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat task.wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer or Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicRivalsCleanup)
end

local function safeRequire(instance)
    if not instance then return end
    local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)
    if ok then return result end
end

local scripts = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
local Gun = safeRequire(scripts:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemTypes"):WaitForChild("Gun"))
local controllers = scripts:WaitForChild("Controllers")
local FighterController = safeRequire(controllers:WaitForChild("FighterController"))
local DuelController = safeRequire(controllers:FindFirstChild("DuelController"))
local Utility = safeRequire(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("Utility"))
if not (Gun and FighterController and Utility) then
    return
end

local State = {
    SilentAim = true,
    AimPart = "Smart",
    ShowFOV = true,
    FOV = 180,
    WallCheck = true,
    StickyTarget = true,
    HitChance = 100,
    MaxHitDistance = 350,
    ESP = true,
}
local lockGrace = 0.18

local Connections = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = c
    return c
end
local function getHumanoid(character)
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
end
local function isAlive(player)
    local humanoid = getHumanoid(player and player.Character)
    return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getLocalDuel()
    if not DuelController or not DuelController.GetDuel then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, duel = pcall(DuelController.GetDuel, DuelController, LocalPlayer)
    return ok and duel or nil
end
local function isEnemy(player)
    if not player or player == LocalPlayer then
        return false
    end
    local duel = getLocalDuel()
    if not duel or not duel.GetDueler then
        return false
    end
    local okMine, myDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, LocalPlayer)
    local okTheirs, theirDueler = pcall(duel.GetDueler, duel, player)
    if not okMine or not okTheirs or not myDueler or not theirDueler then
        return false
    end
    local myTeam
    local theirTeam
    if myDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            myTeam = myDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if theirDueler.Get then
        pcall(function()
            theirTeam = theirDueler:Get("TeamID")
        end)
    end
    if myTeam ~= nil and theirTeam ~= nil then
        return myTeam ~= theirTeam
    end
    return true
end
local RayParams = RaycastParams.new()
RayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
RayParams.IgnoreWater = true
local function updateRayFilter()
    local list = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        table.insert(list, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    RayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = list
end
updateRayFilter()
connect(LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded, function()
    task.defer(updateRayFilter)
end)
local function rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not (origin and character and part) then
        return false
    end
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, part.Position - origin, RayParams)
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end
local function visibleFrom(origin, character, part)
    if not State.WallCheck then
        return true
    end
    return rawVisibleFrom(origin, character, part)
end
local SmartParts = {
    "Head",
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "RightUpperArm",
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "RightUpperLeg",
}
local CurrentTargetPlayer
local CurrentTargetPart
local CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
local function targetParts(character)
    if State.AimPart ~= "Smart" then
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(State.AimPart)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
        print("Join Discord https://discord.gg/axonic")
            return {part}
        end
        return {}
    end
    local parts = {}
    for _, name in ipairs(SmartParts) do
        local part = character and character:FindFirstChild(name)
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            table.insert(parts, part)
        end
    end
    return parts
end
local function getPartMetrics(part)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera or not part then
        return nil
    end
    local screen, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
    if not onScreen or screen.Z <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    local viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(viewport.X * 0.5, viewport.Y * 0.5)
    local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - center).Magnitude
    local worldDistance = (part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
    return screenDistance, worldDistance
end
local function bestPartForPlayer(player)
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then
        return nil
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then
        return nil
    end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local bestPart
    local bestPartScore = math.huge
    local bestScreenDistance
    local bestWorldDistance
    for _, part in ipairs(targetParts(character)) do
        local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
        if screenDistance
            and worldDistance <= State.MaxHitDistance
            and screenDistance <= State.FOV
            and visibleFrom(origin, character, part) then
            local priorityPenalty = 0
            if State.AimPart == "Smart" then
                if part.Name == "Head" then
                    priorityPenalty = 0
                elseif part.Name == "UpperTorso" then
                    priorityPenalty = 1.5
                elseif part.Name == "LowerTorso" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                    priorityPenalty = 3
                else
                    priorityPenalty = 6
                end
            end
            local partScore = screenDistance + priorityPenalty
            if partScore < bestPartScore then
                bestPartScore = partScore
                bestPart = part
                bestScreenDistance = screenDistance
                bestWorldDistance = worldDistance
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPart, bestScreenDistance, bestWorldDistance
end
local function findBestTarget()
    local bestPlayer
    local bestPart
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) and isAlive(player) then
            local part, screenDistance, worldDistance = bestPartForPlayer(player)
            if part then
                local score = screenDistance + worldDistance * 0.035
                if score < bestScore then
                    bestScore = score
                    bestPlayer = player
                    bestPart = part
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestPlayer, bestPart
end
local function lockedTargetStillValid()
    local player = CurrentTargetPlayer
    local part = CurrentTargetPart
    if not State.StickyTarget or not player or not part then
        return false
    end
    if not player.Parent or not part.Parent or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) then
        return false
    end
    local screenDistance, worldDistance = getPartMetrics(part)
    if not screenDistance then
        return false
    end
    if worldDistance > State.MaxHitDistance or screenDistance > State.FOV * 1.20 then
        return false
    end
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if State.WallCheck and (not Camera or not visibleFrom(Camera.CFrame.Position, player.Character, part)) then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
local function acquireTarget(forceFresh)
    local now = os.clock()
    if lockedTargetStillValid() then
        CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
        return CurrentTargetPlayer, CurrentTargetPart
    end
    if (not forceFresh) and CurrentTargetPlayer and State.StickyTarget and lockGrace > 0 then
        if CurrentTargetLostAt == 0 then
            CurrentTargetLostAt = now
            return nil, nil
        end
        if now - CurrentTargetLostAt < lockGrace then
            return nil, nil
        end
    end
    local player, part = findBestTarget()
    CurrentTargetPlayer = player
    CurrentTargetPart = part
    CurrentTargetLostAt = 0
    return player, part
end
local FOVCircle
pcall(function()
    if Drawing and Drawing.new then
        FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
        FOVCircle.Filled = false
        FOVCircle.Thickness = 1
        FOVCircle.NumSides = 80
        FOVCircle.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.85
    end
end)
local OriginalGunStartShooting = Gun.StartShooting
local ShotOffset = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(0.43, 0.25, 0.42))
local ShotKey0 = utf8.char(0)
local ShotKey1 = utf8.char(1)
local ShotKey2 = utf8.char(2)
local ShotKey3 = utf8.char(3)
local function buildShotPayload(origin, target, part)
    local aimCFrame = Utility:EncodeCFrame(CFrame.new(origin, target))
    return {
        [ShotKey0] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey1] = aimCFrame,
        [ShotKey2] = part,
        [ShotKey3] = ShotOffset,
    }
end
local function writeShotPayload(cameraData, payload)
    if type(cameraData) ~= "table" then
        return payload
    end
    cameraData[ShotKey0] = payload[ShotKey0]
    cameraData[ShotKey1] = payload[ShotKey1]
    cameraData[ShotKey2] = payload[ShotKey2]
    cameraData[ShotKey3] = payload[ShotKey3]
    return cameraData
end
Gun.StartShooting = function(self, ...)
    local results = table.pack(OriginalGunStartShooting(self, ...))
    if not self or not self.ClientFighter or not self.ClientFighter.IsLocalPlayer then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if results[1] ~= true or results[2] ~= "StartShooting" then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    if not State.SilentAim or math.random(1, 100) > State.HitChance then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    local targetPlayer, part = acquireTarget(true)
    if not targetPlayer or not part or not part.Parent then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then
        return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
    end

    results[3] = writeShotPayload(results[3], buildShotPayload(root.Position, part.Position, part))
    return table.unpack(results, 1, results.n)
end
local ESPFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
ESPFolder.Name = "_AxonicRivalsESP"
ESPFolder.Parent = Workspace
local ESPObjects = {}

local function removeESP(player)
    local entry = ESPObjects[player]
    if not entry then return end
    if entry.Highlight then entry.Highlight:Destroy() end
    if entry.Gui then entry.Gui:Destroy() end
    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function enemyWeaponName(player)
    if not FighterController or not FighterController.GetFighter then return end
    local ok, fighter = pcall(FighterController.GetFighter, FighterController, player)
    if ok and fighter and fighter.EquippedItem then
        return fighter.EquippedItem.Name
    end
end

local function updateESP()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not State.ESP or not isEnemy(player) or not isAlive(player) or not head then
                removeESP(player)
            else
                local entry = ESPObjects[player]
                if entry and entry.Character ~= character then
                    removeESP(player)
                    entry = nil
                end
                if not entry then
                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "AxonicESP"
                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.72
                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                    highlight.Adornee = character
                    highlight.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    gui.Name = "AxonicName"
                    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(240, 52)
                    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
                    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    gui.Adornee = head
                    gui.Parent = ESPFolder

                    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    text.Name = "Text"
                    text.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    text.TextSize = 14
                    text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
                    text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
                    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    text.TextWrapped = true
                    text.Parent = gui
                    entry = {Character = character, Highlight = highlight, Gui = gui, Label = text}
                    ESPObjects[player] = entry
                end

                local lines = {player.DisplayName}
                local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if root and myRoot then
                    lines[1] = lines[1] .. "  |  " .. math.floor((root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude + .5) .. "m"
                end
                local humanoid = getHumanoid(character)
                local details = {}
                if humanoid then details[#details + 1] = "HP " .. math.floor(humanoid.Health + .5) end
                local weapon = enemyWeaponName(player)
                if weapon then details[#details + 1] = weapon end
                if #details > 0 then lines[#lines + 1] = table.concat(details, "  |  ") end
                entry.Label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
            end
        end
    end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if not player.Parent then removeESP(player) end
    end
end
connect(Players.PlayerRemoving, removeESP)

local discordGui
local lastViewport

local function makeDiscordPopup()
    local parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = parent:FindFirstChild("AxonicRivalsInvite")
    if previous then previous:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AxonicRivalsInvite"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100
    gui.Parent = parent
    discordGui = gui

    local theme = {
        Window = Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15),
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
        Hover = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 35),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 47),
        BorderBright = Color3.fromRGB(64, 66, 75),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 246),
        Muted = Color3.fromRGB(156, 158, 167),
        Faint = Color3.fromRGB(98, 100, 109),
    }

    local function make(class, props, parentObj)
        local instance = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(props) do instance[key] = value end
        instance.Parent = parentObj
        return instance
    end

    local function round(obj, amount)
        make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, amount)}, obj)
    end

    local function outline(obj, color, transparency)
        make("UIStroke", {
            Color = color, Transparency = transparency or 0, Thickness = 1,
        }, obj)
    end

    local function label(obj, value, x, y, w, h, size, color, font)
        return make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = value,
            TextColor3 = color,
            TextSize = size,
            Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        }, obj)
    end

    local width, height = 360, 240
    local panel = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Window",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Window,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    round(panel, 7)
    outline(panel, theme.BorderBright, .34)
    local scale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, panel)

    local header = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 49),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, panel)
    round(header, 7)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)

    label(header, "Axonic", 15, 6, 220, 20, 15, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(header, "RIVALS  /  Open Source", 15, 26, 225, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local dragHandle = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "DragHandle",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Active = true,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, header)

    local close = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 11),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        Text = "×",
        TextSize = 15,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, header)
    round(close, 3)
    outline(close, theme.Border, .3)
    close.MouseEnter:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    close.MouseLeave:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function() gui:Destroy() end)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPosition, touchInput
    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touchInput = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end)

    connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging or not panel.Parent then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= touchInput then return end
        local viewport = Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local halfWidth = panel.AbsoluteSize.X * .5
        local halfHeight = panel.AbsoluteSize.Y * .5
        local centerX = viewport.X * startPosition.X.Scale + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local centerY = viewport.Y * startPosition.Y.Scale + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(centerX, math.min(halfWidth + 8, viewport.X * .5), math.max(viewport.X - halfWidth - 8, viewport.X * .5)),
            math.clamp(centerY, math.min(halfHeight + 8, viewport.Y * .5), math.max(viewport.Y - halfHeight - 8, viewport.Y * .5))
        )
    end)
    connect(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input == touchInput then
            dragging = false
            touchInput = nil
        end
    end)

    label(panel, "OPEN-SOURCE SCRIPTS", 15, 59, 220, 14, 10, theme.Faint, Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    for index, name in ipairs({"Blox Fruits", "Murder Mystery 2", "RIVALS"}) do
        local row = make("Frame", {
            Name = "Game" .. index,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 79 + (index - 1) * 33),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 29),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, panel)
        round(row, 3)
        outline(row, theme.Border, .27)
        label(row, name, 13, 0, 285, 29, 12, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    end

    label(panel, "discord.gg/axonic", 15, 184, 180, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local copyButton = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "CopyDiscordInvite",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 204),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "COPY DISCORD LINK (CLICK)",
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, panel)
    round(copyButton, 4)
    outline(copyButton, theme.BorderBright, .3)
    copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")
        copyButton.Text = copied and "COPIED" or "discord.gg/axonic"
    end)

    local lastViewport
    local function fit()
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport or viewport == lastViewport then return end
        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((viewport.X - 24) / width, (viewport.Y - 24) / height), .6, 1)
    end
    fit()
    connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
        if gui.Parent then fit() end
    end)
end

pcall(makeDiscordPopup)
local tickAccumulator = 0
local espAccumulator = 0
connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function(dt)
    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if FOVCircle then
        local viewport = Camera and Camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.zero
        FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(viewport.X * .5, viewport.Y * .5)
        FOVCircle.Radius = State.FOV
        FOVCircle.Visible = State.SilentAim and State.ShowFOV
    end
    tickAccumulator += dt
    if tickAccumulator >= .016 then
        tickAccumulator = 0
        if State.SilentAim then acquireTarget() end
    end
    espAccumulator += dt
    if espAccumulator >= .15 then
        espAccumulator = 0
        pcall(updateESP)
    end
end)

env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = function()
    State.SilentAim = false
    if Gun.StartShooting ~= OriginalGunStartShooting then
        Gun.StartShooting = OriginalGunStartShooting
    end
    for _, c in ipairs(Connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(Connections)
    if FOVCircle then pcall(function() FOVCircle:Remove() end) end
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do removeESP(player) end
    if ESPFolder then ESPFolder:Destroy() end
    if discordGui then discordGui:Destroy() end
    env.AxonicRivalsCleanup = nil
end
