scripts.code:
-- Join Discord For More Open Sources, Coming Soon https://discord.gg/axonic

repeat
    task.wait()
until game:IsLoaded() and game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local env = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or _G
if type(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop) == "function" then
    pcall(env.AxonicMM2SilentStop)
end
local Connections = {}
local function track(connection)
    Connections[#Connections + 1] = connection
    return connection
end
local function connect(signal, callback)
    return track(signal:Connect(callback))
end
local State = {
    Running = true,
    GunAimV2 = true,
    GunRageMode = false,
    GunAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAim = true,
    KnifeAimV2 = false,
    KnifeRageMode = false,
    KnifeAimTargetPart = "Head",
    KnifeAimFOV = 220,
    RoundCombatSuspended = true,
    WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0,
}
local BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
local OriginalWorkspaceNamecall
local OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction
local WeaponServiceMouseRaw
local WeaponServiceTargetRaw
local getIgnoredParts
local function safeRequire(module)
    if not module or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
    local ok, value = pcall(require, module)
    return ok and value or nil
end
local modules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules", 15)
local CurrentRoundClient = modules and safeRequire(modules:WaitForChild("CurrentRoundClient", 15))
local clientServices = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ClientServices", 15)
local WeaponService = clientServices and safeRequire(clientServices:WaitForChild("WeaponService", 15))
local OriginalWeaponService = {}
if type(WeaponService) == "table" then
    OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
    OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition = WeaponService.GetTargetPosition
end
local function premiumGunAimIsEnabled() return false end
local function getGunRageShotCFrames() return nil, nil, nil end
local function isKnifeWallBangRay() return false end
local function getPremiumGunAimCFrame() return nil, nil, nil end

-- Round data
local function getRoundDataRemote()
    local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local gameplay = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
    local remote = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("GetCurrentPlayerData")
    if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteFunction") then return remote end
    return nil
end
local function getRoundData()
    if type(CurrentRoundClient) == "table" then
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) == "table" and next(CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData) then return CurrentRoundClient.PlayerData end
        if type(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(CurrentRoundClient.GetLatestPlayerData)
            if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
        end
    end
    local remote = getRoundDataRemote()
    if remote then
        local ok, result = pcall(function()
            return remote:InvokeServer()
        end)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then return result end
    end
    return {}
end
local function hasWeaponTool(player, weapon)
    for _, container in ipairs({ player.Character, player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") }) do
        if container then
            for _, child in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Tool") then
                    local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
                    if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                            or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function hasEquippedWeapon(weapon)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return false end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if weapon == "Knife" and (child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                    or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife")) then
                return true
            end
            if weapon == "Gun" and (child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun") then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
    local data = playerData[player.Name]
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Knife") then return "Murderer", data end
    if hasWeaponTool(player, "Gun") then return "Sheriff", data end
    if type(data) == "table" and data.Dead ~= true and type(data.Role) == "string" then return data.Role, data end
    return nil, data
end
local function getRoundIntel()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local intel = { Murderer = {}, Sheriff = {}, Innocent = {}, }
    local alive = 0
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local role, data = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        local isAlive = type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
        local character = player.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then isAlive = false end
        if role == "Hero" then role = "Sheriff" end
        if isAlive then
            alive += 1
            if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Innocent" then
                table.insert(intel[role], player.Name)
            end
        end
    end
    return intel, alive
end
local function isPlaying()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local localData = playerData[LocalPlayer.Name]
    if type(localData) == "table" and localData.Dead == true then return false end
    if hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Gun") or hasWeaponTool(LocalPlayer, "Knife") then return true end
    if type(localData) == "table" then
        local role = localData.Role
        if role == "Murderer" or role == "Sheriff" or role == "Hero" or role == "Innocent" then return true end
    end
    local aliveAttribute = LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Alive")
    if aliveAttribute ~= nil then return aliveAttribute == true end
    return humanoid.Health > 0
end
local function getRoot()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end
local function getInstanceRoot(instance)
    if not instance then return nil end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then return instance end
    if instance:IsA("Model") then return instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    if instance:IsA("Tool") then return instance:FindFirstChild("Handle") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) end
    return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end
local function findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
            if role == "Murderer" then return player end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function playerIsAlive(player, playerData)
    if not player or not player.Character then return false end
    local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local data = playerData and playerData[player.Name]
    return type(data) ~= "table" or data.Dead ~= true
end
local getIgnoredParts
local function getCharacterKnifeAimPart(character, mode)
    if not character then return nil end
    if mode == "Torso" then
        return character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or character:FindFirstChild("Head") or getInstanceRoot(character)
    end
    return character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or getInstanceRoot(character)
end
local function getCrosshair()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return nil end
    local mouseLocation = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local x = mouseLocation.X
    local y = mouseLocation.Y
    local playerScripts = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    local mouseLock = playerScripts and playerScripts:FindFirstChild("MouseLock")
    if mouseLock and mouseLock:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true and UserInputService.PreferredInput ~= Enum.PreferredInput.Gamepad then
        local viewportSize = camera.ViewportSize
        x = viewportSize.X / 2
        y = viewportSize.Y / 2
    end
    return Vector2.new(x, y)
end
local function hasClearShot(origin, targetPart)
    if not origin or not targetPart then return false end
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = getIgnoredParts()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    if not ok then return false end
    return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- Gun
local function getGunTarget(allowWalls)
    local murderer = findMurderer()
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if not murderer or not playerIsAlive(murderer, playerData) or not murderer.Character then return nil, nil, nil end
    local character = murderer.Character
    local preferred
    if State.GunAimTargetPart == "Torso" then
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Head"), }
    else
        preferred = { character:FindFirstChild("Head"), character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"), character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"),
            character:FindFirstChild("Torso"), }
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local origin = camera and camera.CFrame.Position or (root and root.Position)
    local targetPart
    for _, part in ipairs(preferred) do
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            if allowWalls or not origin or hasClearShot(origin, part) then
                targetPart = part
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if not targetPart then return nil, murderer, nil end
    local velocity = targetPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 120 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 120 end
    local distance = root and (targetPart.Position - root.Position).Magnitude or 0
    local leadTime = math.clamp(0.035 + distance / 2200, 0.035, 0.09)
    local predicted = targetPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(predicted), murderer, targetPart
end
local KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
local KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0

-- Knife
local function getKnifeTarget(requireVisible)
    local root = getRoot()
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local aimPoint = getCrosshair()
    if not root or not camera or not aimPoint then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    local viewOrigin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    local now = os.clock()
    local fov = math.max(40, tonumber(State.KnifeAimFOV) or 220)
    local function evaluate(player, sticky)
        if player == LocalPlayer or not playerIsAlive(player, playerData) or not player.Character then return nil end
        local role = getPlayerRole(player, playerData)
        if role == "Murderer" then return nil end
        local part = getCharacterKnifeAimPart( player.Character, State.KnifeAimTargetPart )
        if not part then return nil end
        local screenPosition, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        if not onScreen or screenPosition.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local screenDistance = (Vector2.new(screenPosition.X, screenPosition.Y) - aimPoint).Magnitude
        local allowedFov = sticky and (fov * 1.25) or fov
        if screenDistance > allowedFov then return nil end
        if requireVisible and not hasClearShot(viewOrigin, part) then return nil end
        local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        return part, screenDistance + distance * 0.025, distance
    end
    if KnifeAimStickyPlayer and now <= KnifeAimStickyUntil then
        local part, _, distance = evaluate(KnifeAimStickyPlayer, true)
        if part then
            local velocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
            if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
            local leadTime = math.clamp(distance / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
            return CFrame.new(part.Position + velocity * leadTime), KnifeAimStickyPlayer, part
        end
    end
    local bestTarget
    local bestPart
    local bestDistance
    local bestScore = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local part, score, distance = evaluate(player, false)
        if part and score < bestScore then
            bestTarget = player
            bestPart = part
            bestDistance = distance
            bestScore = score
        end
    end
    if not bestTarget or not bestPart then
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    KnifeAimStickyPlayer = bestTarget
    KnifeAimStickyUntil = now + 0.28
    local velocity = bestPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
    if velocity.Magnitude > 100 then velocity = velocity.Unit * 100 end
    local leadTime = math.clamp((bestDistance or 0) / 180, 0.045, 0.28)
    local targetPosition = bestPart.Position + velocity * leadTime
    return CFrame.new(targetPosition), bestTarget, bestPart
end
function getIgnoredParts()
    local ignored = {}
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        table.insert(ignored, character)
    end
    for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("WeaponPassthrough")) do
        table.insert(ignored, instance)
    end
    return ignored
end
local function raycastForGunAimV2(origin, direction, params)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = true
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if type(OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction) == "function" then
            return OriginalWorkspaceRaycastFunction( workspace, origin, direction, params )
        end
        return workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    end)
    BypassWeaponAimRedirect = false
    return ok and result or nil
end
local function isWeaponRay(origin, direction)
    if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return false end
    local magnitude = direction.Magnitude
    if magnitude < 297 or magnitude > 303 then return false end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then return false end
    if (origin - camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 3.5 then return false end
    if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then
        local ok, caller = pcall(getcallingscript)
        if ok and typeof(caller) == "Instance" then
            local path = string.lower(caller:GetFullName())
            if string.find(path, "camera", 1, true) or string.find(path, "zoom", 1, true) or string.find(path, "occlusion", 1, true) then
                return false
            end
            if string.find(path, "gun", 1, true) or string.find(path, "weapon", 1, true) or string.find(path, "shoot", 1, true)
                or string.find(path, "knife", 1, true) or string.find(path, "projectile", 1, true) then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function raycastToTarget(targetPart)
    if not targetPart or not targetPart.Parent then return nil end
    local targetCharacter = targetPart.Parent
    local targetPosition = targetPart.Position
    local ignored = getIgnoredParts()
    for _, child in ipairs(targetCharacter:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Tool") then
            table.insert(ignored, child)
        end
    end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignored
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local right = targetPart.CFrame.RightVector
    local forward = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
    local offsets = { -forward * 5, forward * 5, right * 5, -right * 5, Vector3.new(0, 5, 0), Vector3.new(0, -4, 0), }
    for _, offset in ipairs(offsets) do
        local origin = targetPosition + offset
        local direction = targetPosition - origin
        if direction.Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local ok, result = pcall(raycastForGunAimV2, origin, direction, params )
            if ok and result and result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetCharacter) then return result end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function getGunRayHit(params)
    local _, murderer, targetPart = getGunTarget(false)
    if not murderer or not targetPart then return nil end
    return raycastToTarget(targetPart)
end
local function getKnifeRayHit()
    local _, targetPlayer, targetPart = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPart then return nil end
    return raycastToTarget(targetPart)
end
local function getGunTargetCFrame()
    local targetCFrame = getGunTarget( false )
    if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
    local result = getGunRayHit()
    if result and result.Position then return CFrame.new( result.Position ) end
    return nil
end
local function getEquippedGunTool()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if child:FindFirstChild("IsGun") or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun" then return child end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Shot redirection
local function isGunShotRemote(instance)
    if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false end
    local lowerName = string.lower(instance.Name)
    local lowerPath = string.lower(instance:GetFullName())
    if not (string.find(lowerName, "shoot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "shot", 1, true) or string.find(lowerName, "fire", 1, true)
        or string.find(lowerName, "hit", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "shootgun", 1, true) or string.find(lowerPath, "knifeserver", 1, true)) then
        return false
    end
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local ancestor = instance.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= game do
        if ancestor:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(ancestor.Name)
            local isGun = ancestor:FindFirstChild("IsGun") ~= nil or CollectionService:HasTag(ancestor, "Weapon_Gun") or lowerToolName == "gun"
            return isGun and ancestor.Parent == character
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return getEquippedGunTool() ~= nil
end
local function getGunRemoteTarget()
    if State.GunRageMode or State.GunAimV2 then
        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getGunTarget(State.GunRageMode == true)
        if targetCFrame and targetPart then return targetCFrame.Position, targetPart end
        return nil, nil
    end
    if premiumGunAimIsEnabled() then
        local targetCFrame, _, targetPart = getPremiumGunAimCFrame()
        if targetCFrame and targetPart then return targetPart.Position, targetPart end
        return nil, nil
    end
    return nil, nil
end
local function rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getGunRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if State.GunRageMode then
            local spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
            if spoofedOrigin and targetCFrame then
                args[1] = spoofedOrigin
                args[2] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        else
            args[2] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        end
    end
    local function replaceArgument(index)
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[index] = targetPosition
            return true
        elseif valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[index] = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Ray" then
            local originalRay = args[index]
            local direction = targetPosition - originalRay.Origin
            if direction.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                args[index] = Ray.new(originalRay.Origin, direction.Unit * math.max(originalRay.Direction.Magnitude, direction.Magnitude) )
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Instance" and args[index] ~= LocalPlayer.Character and targetPart then
            args[index] = targetPart
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and replaceArgument(2) then return true end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        if index ~= 2 and replaceArgument(index) then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function getEquippedKnifeTool()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character then return nil end
    for _, child in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Tool") then
            local lowerToolName = string.lower(child.Name)
            if child:FindFirstChild("Stab") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeClient") or child:FindFirstChild("KnifeLocal")
                or CollectionService:HasTag(child, "Weapon_Knife") or lowerToolName == "knife" then
                return child
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end
local function isKnifeThrowRemote(instance)
    if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not (instance:IsA("RemoteEvent") or instance:IsA("RemoteFunction")) then return false end
    local knife = getEquippedKnifeTool()
    if not knife then return false end
    if instance:IsDescendantOf(knife) then return true end
    local lowerName = string.lower(instance.Name)
    local lowerPath = string.lower(instance:GetFullName())
    return string.find(lowerName, "throw", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(lowerName, "projectile", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(lowerName, "knife", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(lowerPath, "throw", 1, true) ~= nil
        or string.find(lowerPath, "projectile", 1, true) ~= nil or string.find(lowerPath, "knife", 1, true) ~= nil
end
local function getKnifeRemoteTarget()
    if not isPlaying() or not hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then return nil, nil end
    local playerData = getRoundData()
    if getPlayerRole(LocalPlayer, playerData) ~= "Murderer" then return nil, nil end
    if not (State.KnifeAim or (State.KnifeRageMode) or (State.KnifeAimV2)) then return nil, nil end
    local _, targetPlayer, targetPart = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
    if not targetPlayer or not targetPart then
        return nil, nil
    end
    return targetPart.Position, targetPart
end
local function rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
    local targetPosition, targetPart = getKnifeRemoteTarget()
    if not targetPosition then return false end
    local wallBang = State.KnifeRageMode == true
    local spoofedOrigin
    local targetCFrame
    if wallBang then
        spoofedOrigin, targetCFrame = getGunRageShotCFrames(targetPart)
    else
        targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPosition)
    end
    local root = getRoot()
    local normalOrigin = root and root.Position or targetPosition
    local throwOrigin = wallBang and spoofedOrigin and spoofedOrigin.Position or normalOrigin
    local throwDirection = targetPosition - throwOrigin
    if throwDirection.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        throwDirection = throwDirection.Unit
    else
        throwDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
    end
    if argumentCount == 1 then
        local valueType = typeof(args[1])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            args[1] = targetCFrame
            return true
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            args[1] = args[1].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
            return true
        end
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "CFrame" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = targetCFrame
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "CFrame" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    if argumentCount >= 2 and typeof(args[1]) == "Vector3" and typeof(args[2]) == "Vector3" then
        if wallBang and spoofedOrigin then
            args[1] = spoofedOrigin.Position
        end
        args[2] = args[2].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
        return true
    end
    for index = 1, argumentCount do
        local valueType = typeof(args[index])
        if valueType == "CFrame" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin
            else
                args[index] = targetCFrame
                return true
            end
        elseif valueType == "Vector3" then
            if wallBang and index == 1 and argumentCount > 1 and spoofedOrigin then
                args[index] = spoofedOrigin.Position
            else
                args[index] = args[index].Magnitude <= 5 and throwDirection or targetPosition
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function sendWeaponRemote(remote, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "FireServer" then
        remote.FireServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
        return nil
    end
    return remote.InvokeServer(remote, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end
local function callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    if method == "Raycast" or method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
        local ok, directMethod = pcall(function()
            return self[method]
        end)
        if ok and type(directMethod) == "function" then return directMethod(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount)) end
    end
    return OriginalWorkspaceNamecall(self, table.unpack(args, 1, argumentCount))
end

-- Weapon hooks
local function installNamecallHook()
    if OriginalWorkspaceNamecall or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return end
    local namecallHook
    namecallHook = function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args = { ... }
        local argumentCount = select("#", ...)
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isKnifeThrowRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteKnifeArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if not State.RoundCombatSuspended and (State.GunAimV2 or State.GunRageMode or premiumGunAimIsEnabled())
            and (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer") and isGunShotRemote(self) then
            local rewritten = rewriteGunArgs(args, argumentCount)
            if rewritten then
                local dispatchResults = table.pack(pcall(sendWeaponRemote, self, method, args, argumentCount ))
                if not dispatchResults[1] then return nil end
                State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                return table.unpack(dispatchResults, 2, dispatchResults.n)
            end
            State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
            return sendWeaponRemote(self, method, args, argumentCount)
        end
        if self == workspace and method == "Raycast" and not BypassWeaponAimRedirect and not State.RoundCombatSuspended and isPlaying() then
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") and not State.GunRageMode and (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]) then
                local result = getGunRayHit(args[3])
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
            if hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") and (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2))
                and ((State.KnifeRageMode and isKnifeWallBangRay(args[1], args[2])) or (not State.KnifeRageMode and isWeaponRay(args[1], args[2]))) then
                local result = getKnifeRayHit()
                if result then
                    State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
        return callOriginal(self, method, args, argumentCount)
    end
    OriginalWorkspaceNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", type(newcclosure) == "function" and newcclosure(namecallHook) or namecallHook )
end

local function installWeaponHook()
    if type(WeaponService) ~= "table" or WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked then return end
    WeaponService.AxonicAimHooked = true
    local function redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if State.RoundCombatSuspended then return nil end
        if os.clock() > (State.WeaponRayWindowUntil or 0) then return nil end
        if (State.GunAimV2 or premiumGunAimIsEnabled()) and not State.GunRageMode and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Gun") then
            local targetCFrame = getGunTargetCFrame()
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        if (State.KnifeAim or State.KnifeRageMode or (State.KnifeAimV2)) and isPlaying() and hasEquippedWeapon("Knife") then
            local targetCFrame = getKnifeTarget(State.KnifeRageMode ~= true)
            if targetCFrame then return targetCFrame end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local mouseWrapper
    local targetWrapper
    mouseWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceMouseRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    targetWrapper = function(...)
        local redirected = redirectedTargetCFrame()
        if redirected then return redirected end
        local raw = WeaponServiceTargetRaw or OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        if type(raw) == "function" then return raw(...) end
        return CFrame.new()
    end
    if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
        mouseWrapper = newcclosure(mouseWrapper)
        targetWrapper = newcclosure(targetWrapper)
    end
    local hooked = false
    if type(hookfunction) == "function" and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame) == "function"
        and type(OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition) == "function" then
        local okMouse, rawMouse = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame, mouseWrapper )
        local okTarget, rawTarget = pcall(hookfunction, OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition, targetWrapper )
        if okMouse and okTarget and type(rawMouse) == "function" and type(rawTarget) == "function" then
            WeaponServiceMouseRaw = rawMouse
            WeaponServiceTargetRaw = rawTarget
            hooked = true
        end
    end
    if not hooked then
        WeaponServiceMouseRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame
        WeaponServiceTargetRaw = OriginalWeaponService.GetTargetPosition
        WeaponService.GetMouseTargetCFrame = mouseWrapper
        WeaponService.GetTargetPosition = targetWrapper
    end
end

-- Round state
local function updateRoundState()
    local ok, intel, alive = pcall(getRoundIntel)
    if ok and intel then
        State.RoundCombatSuspended = not (#intel.Murderer > 0 and alive > 1)
    else

    end
    if State.RoundCombatSuspended then
        State.WeaponRayWindowUntil = 0
        KnifeAimStickyPlayer = nil
        KnifeAimStickyUntil = 0
    end
end

--[[
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
	 CONVEYOR AUTO  ·  Anime Card Farm            (NextUI edition)
	 Авторолл конвейера + автопокупка паков по белому списку мутаций.
	 Один файл LocalScript. Запуск через исполнитель (Madium / любой с
	 fireclickdetector).

	 ИНТЕРФЕЙС ПЕРЕПИСАН НА NextUI — https://diser.me/nextui/
	   Вся ручная отрисовка (ScreenGui, твины, скроллы, свои дропдауны,
	   тосты, перетаскивание окна) удалена. Теперь окно, вкладки, карточки,
	   переключатели, слайдеры, дропдауны, мультиселекты, кейбинды,
	   уведомления, поиск по элементам, темы и «стекло» — из библиотеки.
	   Логика (конфиг, скан плота, данные паков, remote, движок) не менялась.
	═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

	ЧТО ДЕЛАЕТ
	  • Крутит кнопку "Spawn Pack" на твоём плоте (клик по ClickDetector).
	  • Читает события ConveyorRE: какой пак выпал и с какой мутацией.
	  • Покупает пак только если ОН включён в списке И его мутация отмечена.
	  • Останавливается при "Not enough money" (опция, по умолчанию включена).
	  • Настройки сохраняются в файл и переживают реджойн.

	ЧЕГО НЕ ДЕЛАЕТ
	  • Не продаёт карты, не качает апгрейды, не трогает другие системы.
	  • Не покупает паки, которые не спавнятся кнопкой (Robux-only исключены).

	ВКЛАДКИ
	  Autoroll  — главный переключатель, интервал ролла, джиттер,
	              живой статус, счётчики, «последний увиденный пак».
	  Packs     — выбранный пак + список мутаций для покупки,
	              массовое включение/выключение, применение мутаций ко всем.
	  Settings  — поведение, горячие клавиши, хранилище, обслуживание.

	ГОРЯЧИЕ КЛАВИШИ
	  RightShift или Insert — показать/скрыть окно (меняется в Settings).
	  R                     — старт/стоп авторолла (кнопка клавиши в строке
	                          Autoroll на вкладке Autoroll).
	  Поиск по всем элементам — строка поиска в шапке окна (клавиша «/»).

	КОНСОЛЬ
	  Все сообщения скрипта помечены префиксом [CA].

	СЕКЦИИ
	  CONFIG → STORE → UTIL → SCANNER → DATA → NET → ENGINE → UI → BOOT
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
]]

--============================================================
-- 0. HEADER — служебные константы и сервисы
--============================================================

local SCRIPT_NAME = "ConveyorAuto"
local VERSION = "2.0.0"
local LOG_PREFIX = "[CA]"
local NEXTUI_URL = "https://diser.me/nextui/source.lua"

if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not player then
	repeat
		task.wait()
	until Players.LocalPlayer
	player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

--============================================================
-- 1. CONFIG — дефолтные настройки (UI сохраняет значения поверх)
--============================================================

local CONFIG = {
	version = 2,

	-- Интервал между прокрутками в миллисекундах.
	-- Сервер держит CanPress=false ~650 мс, поэтому ниже 700 смысла нет.
	timingMs = 800,
	minTimingMs = 700,
	maxTimingMs = 60000,
	-- Случайная добавка к интервалу (0..jitterMs), чтобы не долбить ровно в такт.
	jitterMs = 60,
	maxJitterMs = 600,

	-- Клавиши. Храним именами KeyCode ("R", "RightShift", ...).
	keybinds = {
		toggleUI = "RightShift",
		toggleRoll = "R",
	},

	options = {
		-- Останавливать авторолл, когда сервер вернул NotEnoughMoney.
		stopOnNoMoney = true,
		-- Запускать авторолл сразу при загрузке скрипта.
		autoStart = false,
		-- Показывать оверлей со списком горячих клавиш NextUI.
		showBindList = false,
	},

	-- Где хранить настройки: "auto" (файл, если доступен, иначе атрибуты),
	-- "file" (только файл), "attributes" (только атрибуты внутри игры).
	storage = "auto",
	storageFolder = "AnimeCardFarm",
	storageFile = "ConveyorAuto.json",

	-- Порядок мутаций в списках: редчайшие сверху.
	-- Первые четыре зафиксированы вручную (у них Weight = 0),
	-- остальные сортируются по Weight по возрастанию автоматически.
	-- Значения — «сырые» имена мутаций из модуля игры.
	mutationOrder = { "Nightmare", "Unknow", "Nullstar", "Admin" },

	--═══ ПОЛНАЯ КАСТОМИЗАЦИЯ ПОКУПОК ═══
	-- Ключ — Id пака из ReplicatedStorage.Modules.ConveyorPacks.
	-- enabled = true  → скрипт вообще рассматривает этот пак.
	-- mutations[имя] = true → покупать только с этой мутацией.
	-- Пустой mutations = пак включён, но не покупается (нет разрешённых мутаций).
	packs = {
		-- Пример (раскомментируй и поправь под себя):
		-- ["Ice Pack"] = {
		-- 	enabled = true,
		-- 	mutations = { Normal = true, Golden = true },
		-- },
	},
	-- Служебный флаг: true, когда паки уже настраивались в UI/сохранены.
	packsConfigured = false,
}

--============================================================
-- 2. STORE — сохранение/загрузка конфига (JSON-файл или атрибуты)
--============================================================

local Store = {}
local state = nil
local storageMode = "attributes"
local dataHolder = nil
local saveSeq = 0

local function deepCopy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for k, v in pairs(value) do
		copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
	end
	return copy
end

-- Аккуратно накладывает загруженные значения на дефолты:
-- типы должны совпадать, неизвестные ключи игнорируются.
local function mergeDefaults(base, incoming)
	if type(incoming) ~= "table" then
		return base
	end
	for k, v in pairs(incoming) do
		local current = base[k]
		if type(current) == "table" and type(v) == "table" then
			mergeDefaults(current, v)
		elseif current ~= nil then
			if type(current) == type(v) then
				base[k] = v
			end
		else
			base[k] = deepCopy(v)
		end
	end
	return base
end

local function clampTiming(value)
	local minValue = CONFIG.minTimingMs
	local maxValue = CONFIG.maxTimingMs
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return CONFIG.timingMs
	end
	n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
	if n < minValue then
		n = minValue
	end
	if n > maxValue then
		n = maxValue
	end
	return n
end

local function clampJitter(value)
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return CONFIG.jitterMs
	end
	n = math.floor(n + 0.5)
	if n < 0 then
		n = 0
	end
	if n > CONFIG.maxJitterMs then
		n = CONFIG.maxJitterMs
	end
	return n
end

-- Кейбинды хранятся строкой ("R"), но старые конфиги с таблицей тоже читаем.
local function normalizeKeyName(raw, fallback)
	if type(raw) == "table" then
		raw = raw.key
	end
	if type(raw) == "string" and raw ~= "" then
		local ok, code = pcall(function()
			return Enum.KeyCode[raw]
		end)
		if ok and code then
			return raw
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

local function normalizeConfig(raw)
	local cfg = deepCopy(CONFIG)
	local savedPacks = nil

	if type(raw) == "table" then
		-- Паки применяем атомарно: если в сохранённом конфиге есть список паков,
		-- он полностью заменяет дефолты из CONFIG (иначе снятые галочки
		-- «возвращались» бы из шапки файла).
		local incoming = deepCopy(raw)
		if type(incoming.packs) == "table" then
			savedPacks = incoming.packs
			incoming.packs = nil
		end
		mergeDefaults(cfg, incoming)
	end

	if savedPacks and cfg.packsConfigured == true then
		cfg.packs = savedPacks
	end

	cfg.timingMs = clampTiming(cfg.timingMs)
	cfg.jitterMs = clampJitter(cfg.jitterMs)
	cfg.keybinds.toggleUI = normalizeKeyName(cfg.keybinds.toggleUI, CONFIG.keybinds.toggleUI)
	cfg.keybinds.toggleRoll = normalizeKeyName(cfg.keybinds.toggleRoll, CONFIG.keybinds.toggleRoll)
	if type(cfg.packs) ~= "table" then
		cfg.packs = {}
	end
	-- Чистим мусорные записи паков, чтобы движок не спотыкался.
	for packId, entry in pairs(cfg.packs) do
		if type(entry) ~= "table" then
			cfg.packs[packId] = nil
		else
			if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
				entry.mutations = {}
			end
			entry.enabled = entry.enabled == true
			for mutName, allowed in pairs(entry.mutations) do
				if allowed ~= true then
					entry.mutations[mutName] = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return cfg
end

local function getHolder()
	local playerGui = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then
		playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
	end
	if not playerGui then
		return nil
	end
	local holder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ConveyorAutoData")
	if not holder then
		holder = Instance.new("Folder")
		holder.Name = "ConveyorAutoData"
		holder.Parent = playerGui
	end
	return holder
end

local function hasFileApi()
	return type(writefile) == "function"
		and type(readfile) == "function"
		and type(isfile) == "function"
		and type(makefolder) == "function"
end

local function folderExists(path)
	if type(isfolder) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(isfolder, path)
		return ok and value == true
	end
	return false
end

local function resolveStorage()
	if CONFIG.storage == "file" then
		storageMode = hasFileApi() and "file" or "attributes"
	elseif CONFIG.storage == "attributes" then
		storageMode = "attributes"
	else
		storageMode = hasFileApi() and "file" or "attributes"
	end
end

local function fullPath()
	return CONFIG.storageFolder .. "/" .. CONFIG.storageFile
end

local function readRaw()
	if storageMode == "file" then
		local ok, contents = pcall(readfile, fullPath())
		if ok and type(contents) == "string" and contents ~= "" then
			return contents, "file"
		end
		return nil, "file"
	end
	if dataHolder then
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return dataHolder:GetAttribute("Config")
		end)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" then
			return value, "attributes"
		end
	end
	return nil, "attributes"
end

local function writeRaw(payload)
	if storageMode == "file" then
		if not folderExists(CONFIG.storageFolder) then
			pcall(makefolder, CONFIG.storageFolder)
		end
		local ok, err = pcall(writefile, fullPath(), payload)
		if not ok then
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN file save failed: " .. tostring(err))
			return false
		end
		return true
	end
	if dataHolder then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			dataHolder:SetAttribute("Config", payload)
		end)
		return ok
	end
	return false
end

function Store.init()
	resolveStorage()
	dataHolder = getHolder()

	local raw, source = readRaw()
	local loaded = nil
	if raw then
		local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
		end)
		if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
			loaded = decoded
		else
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN config is corrupted, using defaults (" .. source .. ")")
		end
	end

	state = normalizeConfig(loaded)
	Store.save(true)

	if storageMode == "file" then
		print(LOG_PREFIX .. " storage: file → " .. fullPath())
	else
		warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN storage: PlayerGui attributes (settings reset on rejoin)")
	end
	return state
end

function Store.get()
	if not state then
		state = normalizeConfig(nil)
	end
	return state
end

-- Возвращает запись пака, создавая её при необходимости (только для записи).
function Store.packEntry(packId)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	local entry = cfg.packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" then
		entry = { enabled = false, mutations = {} }
		cfg.packs[packId] = entry
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		entry.mutations = {}
	end
	cfg.packsConfigured = true
	return entry
end

-- Только чтение: ничего не создаёт (чтобы не засорять конфиг).
function Store.readPack(packId)
	local entry = Store.get().packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		entry.mutations = {}
	end
	return entry
end

function Store.isAllowed(packId, mutation)
	local entry = Store.get().packs[packId]
	if type(entry) ~= "table" or entry.enabled ~= true then
		return false
	end
	if type(entry.mutations) ~= "table" then
		return false
	end
	return entry.mutations[mutation] == true
end

function Store.save(immediate)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	saveSeq = saveSeq + 1
	local token = saveSeq

	local function doSave()
		local ok, payload = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONEncode(state)
		end)
		if not ok or type(payload) ~= "string" then
			warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " WARN config encode failed")
			return
		end
		writeRaw(payload)
	end

	if immediate then
		doSave()
	else
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			if token == saveSeq then
				doSave()
			end
		end)
	end
end

function Store.reset()
	state = normalizeConfig(nil)
	Store.save(true)
end

function Store.setTiming(ms)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	cfg.timingMs = clampTiming(ms)
	Store.save()
	return cfg.timingMs
end

function Store.setJitter(ms)
	local cfg = Store.get()
	cfg.jitterMs = clampJitter(ms)
	Store.save()
	return cfg.jitterMs
end

function Store.isFileMode()
	return storageMode == "file"
end

local connections = {}

local function track(connection)
	connections[#connections + 1] = connection
	return connection
end

local function log(...)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end
	print(LOG_PREFIX .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
end

local function warnLog(...)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 1, select("#", ...) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = tostring(select(i, ...))
	end
	warn(LOG_PREFIX .. " " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
end

local function safeRequire(module)
	if typeof(module) ~= "Instance" or not module:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	if ok then
		return result
	end
	warnLog("WARN require failed: " .. module:GetFullName() .. " → " .. tostring(result))
	return nil
end

local function clamp(value, minValue, maxValue)
	if value < minValue then
		return minValue
	elseif value > maxValue then
		return maxValue
	end
	return value
end

local function round(value)
	return math.floor(value + 0.5)
end

local function formatPrice(value)
	local n = tonumber(value)
	if not n then
		return tostring(value)
	end
	local abs = math.abs(n)
	if abs >= 1e12 then
		return string.format("%.2fT", n / 1e12)
	elseif abs >= 1e9 then
		return string.format("%.2fB", n / 1e9)
	elseif abs >= 1e6 then
		return string.format("%.2fM", n / 1e6)
	elseif abs >= 1e3 then
		return string.format("%.1fK", n / 1e3)
	end
	return tostring(round(n))
end

-- Строка "R" → Enum.KeyCode.R (без падений на кривых конфигах).
local function keyCodeOf(name, fallback)
	local ok, code = pcall(function()
		return Enum.KeyCode[tostring(name)]
	end)
	if ok and typeof(code) == "EnumItem" then
		return code
	end
	return fallback or Enum.KeyCode.R
end

function Scanner.refresh()
	local plotNumber, plotValue = getPlotNumber()
	Scanner.plotNumber = plotNumber
	Scanner.plot = nil
	Scanner.buttonPart = nil
	Scanner.clickDetector = nil
	Scanner.localModels = nil

	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("MAP")
	local plots = map and map:FindFirstChild("Plots")
	if plots and plotNumber ~= nil then
		local plot = plots:FindFirstChild(tostring(plotNumber))
		if plot then
			local plotN0 = plot:FindFirstChild("Plot_N0")
			Scanner.plot = plotN0 or plot
		end
	end

	if Scanner.plot then
		local button = Scanner.plot:FindFirstChild("ButtonPart")
		if not button then
			-- на всякий случай ищем вглубь, но только кнопку с ClickDetector
			for _, descendant in ipairs(Scanner.plot:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant.Name == "ButtonPart" and descendant:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") then
					button = descendant
					break
				end
			end

		if button then
			Scanner.buttonPart = button
			Scanner.clickDetector = button:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
				or button:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true)
		end

		Scanner.mutationDisplay = safeRequire(
			ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Modules")
				and ReplicatedStorage.Modules:FindFirstChild("MutationDisplay")
		)
	end)
	if not ok then
		Scanner.mutationDisplay = nil
	end

	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if remotes then
		Scanner.conveyorRE = remotes:FindFirstChild("ConveyorRE")
	end

	local gradients = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("UiGradient")
	if gradients then
		Scanner.mutationGradients = gradients:FindFirstChild("Mutations")
		Scanner.rarityGradients = gradients:FindFirstChild("Rarity")
	end

	if not Scanner.buttonPart or not Scanner.clickDetector then
		warnLog("WARN spawn button not found (plot " .. tostring(plotNumber) .. ") — rolling disabled")
	end
	return Scanner.buttonPart ~= nil and Scanner.clickDetector ~= nil

-- Проверяет, что цель жива; при необходимости пере-сканирует.
function Scanner.ensure()

	return Scanner.refresh()

	local ok, value = pcall(function()
		return button:GetAttribute("CanPress")

	if not ok then

	return value

-- Сэмплирует первый ключевой кадр UIGradient по имени (для цвета чипа).
local function gradientColor(folder, name, fallback)
	if not folder then
		return fallback
	end
	local gradient = folder:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not gradient then
		gradient = folder:FindFirstChild(name .. "1")
	end
	if gradient and gradient:IsA("UIGradient") then
		local ok, sequence = pcall(function()
			return gradient.Color
		end)
		if ok and typeof(sequence) == "ColorSequence" then
			local keypoints = sequence.Keypoints
			if keypoints and #keypoints > 0 then
				return keypoints[1].Value
			end
		end
	end
	return fallback
end

-- 5. DATA — нормализованные паки и мутации из модуля игры
--============================================================

local Data = {
	packs = {},
	packById = {},
	mutations = {},
	mutationByName = {},
	packsModule = nil,
	ready = false,
}

local FALLBACK_MUTATION_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(180, 190, 210)
local FALLBACK_RARITY_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(110, 120, 145)

local function displayMutation(name)
	local display = Scanner.mutationDisplay
	if display and type(display.GetDisplayName) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(display.GetDisplayName, name)
		if ok and type(value) == "string" then
			return value
		end
	end
	if name == "Unknow" then
		return "Unknown"
	end
	return name
end

function Data.build()
	Data.packs = {}
	Data.packById = {}
	Data.mutations = {}
	Data.mutationByName = {}
	Data.ready = false

	local moduleInstance = findPacksModule()
	local module = safeRequire(moduleInstance)
	if not module or type(module.List) ~= "table" then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorPacks module not available — pack list disabled")
		return false
	end

	Data.packsModule = module
	Scanner.packsModule = module

	local rarityRank = type(module.RarityRank) == "table" and module.RarityRank or {}

	--═══ Паки: Robux-only и «мёртвые» (Weight <= 0) полностью исключены ═══
	for _, pack in ipairs(module.List) do
		local skip = pack.RobuxOnly == true
		if not skip and (tonumber(pack.Weight) or 0) <= 0 then
			skip = true
		end
		if not skip then
			local rank = tonumber(rarityRank[pack.Rarity]) or 99
			local entry = {
				id = tostring(pack.Id),
				rarity = tostring(pack.Rarity or "Unknown"),
				rarityRank = rank,
				price = tonumber(pack.Price) or 0,
				weight = tonumber(pack.Weight) or 0,
				openTime = tonumber(pack.OpenTime) or 0,
				color = gradientColor(Scanner.rarityGradients, tostring(pack.Rarity), FALLBACK_RARITY_COLOR),
			}
			Data.packs[#Data.packs + 1] = entry
			Data.packById[entry.id] = entry
		end
	end

	table.sort(Data.packs, function(a, b)
		if a.rarityRank ~= b.rarityRank then
			return a.rarityRank < b.rarityRank
		end
		return a.id < b.id
	end)

	--═══ Мутации: сначала ручной порядок, затем по Weight (редчайшие сверху) ═══
	local orderIndex = {}
	for index, name in ipairs(CONFIG.mutationOrder) do
		orderIndex[name] = index
	end

	for _, mutation in ipairs(module.Mutations or {}) do
		local name = tostring(mutation.Name)
		local entry = {
			name = name,
			display = displayMutation(name),
			weight = tonumber(mutation.Weight) or 0,
			multiplier = tonumber(mutation.PriceMultiplier) or 1,
			eventOnly = mutation.EventOnly == true,
			color = gradientColor(Scanner.mutationGradients, name, FALLBACK_MUTATION_COLOR),
		}
		Data.mutations[#Data.mutations + 1] = entry
		Data.mutationByName[name] = entry
	end

	table.sort(Data.mutations, function(a, b)
		local aIndex = orderIndex[a.name]
		local bIndex = orderIndex[b.name]
		if aIndex and bIndex then
			return aIndex < bIndex
		elseif aIndex then
			return true
		elseif bIndex then
			return false
		end
		if a.weight ~= b.weight then
			return a.weight < b.weight
		end
		return a.name < b.name
	end)

	Data.ready = #Data.packs > 0 and #Data.mutations > 0
	return Data.ready
end

function Data.getPack(packId)
	return Data.packById[packId]
end

function Data.getMutation(name)
	return Data.mutationByName[name]
end

local Engine
local UI
local destroy

local Net = {
	remote = nil,
	onEvent = nil,
	buySent = {},
	clickMode = "none",
}

local random = Random.new()

local function markBuySent(itemId)
	Net.buySent[itemId] = os.clock()
	-- Чистим старые записи, чтобы таблица не росла бесконечно.
	local now = os.clock()
	for key, at in pairs(Net.buySent) do
		if now - at > 60 then
			Net.buySent[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Клик по кнопке спавна: сначала fireclickdetector, затем мышь.
function Net.click()
	local detector = Scanner.clickDetector
	if not detector then
		return false, "no-detector"
	end

	if type(fireclickdetector) == "function" then
		local ok = pcall(fireclickdetector, detector)
		if ok then
			Net.clickMode = "clickdetector"
			return true
		end
	end

	-- Fallback: наводим мышь на кнопку и кликаем.
	if type(mousemoveabs) == "function" and type(mouse1click) == "function" then
		local part = Scanner.buttonPart
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if part and camera then
			local okPoint, screenPoint = pcall(function()
				return camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			end)
			if okPoint and screenPoint then
				pcall(mousemoveabs, screenPoint.X, screenPoint.Y)
				pcall(mouse1click)
				Net.clickMode = "mouse"
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	Net.clickMode = "none"
	return false, "no-input"
end

-- Покупка пака, который уже доехал до точки B. Один раз на ItemId.
function Net.tryBuy(itemId)
	if itemId == nil or Net.buySent[itemId] then
		return false
	end
	local remote = Net.remote
	if not remote then
		return false
	end
	markBuySent(itemId)
	local ok = pcall(function()
		remote:FireServer("TryBuy", { ItemId = itemId })
	end)
	if not ok then
		warnLog("WARN TryBuy failed for item " .. tostring(itemId))
	end
	return ok
end

function Net.init()
	local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
	if not remotes then
		remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
	end
	Net.remote = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("ConveyorRE")
	if not Net.remote then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorRE not found — remote logic disabled")
		return false
	end

	track(Net.remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action, data)
		if Net.onEvent then
			local ok, err = pcall(Net.onEvent, action, data)
			if not ok then
				warnLog("WARN event handler error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end))

	log("remote ready: " .. Net.remote:GetFullName())
	return true
end

-- 7. ENGINE — цикл авторолла и автопокупки
--============================================================

Engine = {
	running = false,
	status = "STOPPED",
	readyAt = 0,
	lastClickAt = 0,
	lastItem = nil,
	stats = {
		rolls = 0,
		seen = 0,
		bought = 0,
		skipped = 0,
		failed = 0,
	},
	seq = {
		ack = 0,
		spawn = 0,
		buy = 0,
		resolve = 0,
	},
	pending = {}, -- itemId → { packId, mutation, price, rarity, at }
	flags = {},   -- itemId → { packAtB, buyPending, resolved }
}

local function cleanupMaps()
	local now = os.clock()
	for itemId, info in pairs(Engine.pending) do
		if now - (info.at or now) > 60 then
			Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
			Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
		end
	end
	for itemId, flag in pairs(Engine.flags) do
		if flag.resolved and now - (flag.at or now) > 60 then
			Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
		end
	end
end

local function packLabel(info)
	if not info then
		return "pack", "mutation"
	end
	local pack = Data.getPack(info.packId)
	local mutation = Data.getMutation(info.mutation)
	local packName = pack and pack.id or tostring(info.packId)
	local mutationName = mutation and mutation.display or tostring(info.mutation)
	return packName, mutationName
end

local function resolveItem(itemId, kind, reason)
	local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
	if not flag or flag.resolved then
		return
	end
	flag.resolved = true
	flag.at = os.clock()
	Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1

	local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
	local packName, mutationName = packLabel(info)

	if kind == "bought" then
		Engine.stats.bought = Engine.stats.bought + 1
		if UI then
			UI.notify("good", "Bought", packName .. " · " .. mutationName)
		end
	elseif kind == "failed" then
		Engine.stats.failed = Engine.stats.failed + 1
		if reason == "NotEnoughMoney" then
			local stopOnNoMoney = Store.get().options.stopOnNoMoney ~= false
			if UI then
				UI.notify("danger", "Not enough money", stopOnNoMoney and "Autoroll stopped" or "Autoroll keeps rolling")
			end
			if stopOnNoMoney then
				warnLog("WARN not enough money — stopping")
				Engine.stop("NO MONEY")
			end
		elseif UI then
			UI.notify("danger", "Buy failed", tostring(reason or "unknown"))
		end
	end

	Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end
end

-- Обработчик всех событий ConveyorRE.
function Engine.handleEvent(action, data)
	if action == "ButtonClicked" then
		Engine.seq.ack = Engine.seq.ack + 1
		if type(data) == "table" and data.PlotNumber ~= nil and Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
			if tostring(data.PlotNumber) ~= tostring(Scanner.plotNumber) then
				Engine.seq.ack = Engine.seq.ack - 1
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if action == "PurchaseSound" then
		return
	end

	if type(data) ~= "table" then
		return
	end

	-- События чужого плота игнорируем.
	if data.PlotNumber ~= nil and Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
		if tostring(data.PlotNumber) ~= tostring(Scanner.plotNumber) then
			return
		end
	end

	local itemId = data.ItemId
	if itemId == nil then
		return
	end

	if action == "SpawnAndMoveToB" then
		cleanupMaps()
		Engine.pending[itemId] = {
			itemId = itemId,
			packId = tostring(data.PackId or data.PackAssetName or "Unknown"),
			mutation = tostring(data.Mutation or "Normal"),
			price = tonumber(data.Price) or 0,
			rarity = tostring(data.Rarity or ""),
			at = os.clock(),
		}
		Engine.flags[itemId] = { at = os.clock() }
		Engine.lastItem = itemId
		Engine.seq.spawn = Engine.seq.spawn + 1
		Engine.stats.seen = Engine.stats.seen + 1
		if UI then
			UI.updateStats()
		end
	elseif action == "PackAtB" then
		local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
		if not info then
			return
		end
		local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
		if not flag then
			flag = { at = os.clock() }
			Engine.flags[itemId] = flag
		end
		flag.packAtB = true

		local allowed = Store.isAllowed(info.packId, info.mutation)
		if not allowed then
			if UI then
				UI.updateLastSeen(info)
			end
			return
		end

		flag.buyPending = true
		Engine.seq.buy = Engine.seq.buy + 1
		local delay = 0.06 + random:NextNumber(0, 0.14)
		task.delay(delay, function()
			if not Engine.running then
				if not flag.resolved then
					flag.resolved = true
					Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1
				end
				return
			end
			if not flag.resolved then
				Net.tryBuy(itemId)
			end
		end)
	elseif action == "BoughtAndRemove" then
		resolveItem(itemId, "bought")
	elseif action == "BuyFailed" then
		resolveItem(itemId, "failed", data.Reason)
	elseif action == "MoveToCAndDestroy" then
		local flag = Engine.flags[itemId]
		local info = Engine.pending[itemId]
		if info and (not flag or not flag.resolved) then
			Engine.stats.skipped = Engine.stats.skipped + 1
			if UI then
				UI.updateStats()
			end
		end
		if flag and not flag.resolved then
			flag.resolved = true
			flag.at = os.clock()
			Engine.seq.resolve = Engine.seq.resolve + 1
		end
		Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
	elseif action == "RecoverRollback" or action == "DestroyOrphanedPack" then
		Engine.pending[itemId] = nil
		Engine.flags[itemId] = nil
	end
end

function Engine.setStatus(status)
	Engine.status = status
	if UI then
		UI.setStatus(status)
	end
end

-- Один шаг цикла: клик → ожидание пака → ожидание покупки.
function Engine.step()
	local cfg = Store.get()
	local interval = math.max(CONFIG.minTimingMs, tonumber(cfg.timingMs) or CONFIG.timingMs) / 1000
	local jitter = (tonumber(cfg.jitterMs) or CONFIG.jitterMs) / 1000

	if not Scanner.ensure() then
		if Engine.status ~= "NOT READY" then
			Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		end
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end

	if Engine.status == "NOT READY" then
		Engine.setStatus("RUNNING")
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	if now < Engine.readyAt then
		task.wait(math.min(0.05, Engine.readyAt - now))
		return
	end

	local canPress = Scanner.getCanPress()
	if canPress == false then
		task.wait(0.08)
		return
	end

	local spawnBefore = Engine.seq.spawn
	local clickAt = os.clock()
	local clicked, reason = Net.click()
	if not clicked then
		warnLog("WARN roll click failed: " .. tostring(reason))
		Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		task.wait(1)
		return
	end

	Engine.stats.rolls = Engine.stats.rolls + 1
	Engine.lastClickAt = clickAt
	Engine.readyAt = clickAt + interval + random:NextNumber(0, jitter)
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end

	-- Ждём подтверждение спавна от сервера.
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while Engine.running and Engine.seq.spawn == spawnBefore and os.clock() - t0 < 2 do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	if Engine.seq.spawn == spawnBefore then
		warnLog("WARN no spawn confirmation within 2s")
		if Engine.running then
			Engine.setStatus("NOT READY")
		end
		task.wait(0.5)
		return
	end

	local itemId = Engine.lastItem
	local flag = itemId and Engine.flags[itemId]
	if flag then
		-- Ждём, пока пак доедет до точки B.
		local t1 = os.clock()
		while Engine.running and not flag.packAtB and not flag.resolved and os.clock() - t1 < 2 do
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
		-- Если покупка запрошена — ждём её результат.
		if flag.buyPending and not flag.resolved then
			local t2 = os.clock()
			while Engine.running and not flag.resolved and os.clock() - t2 < 2 do
				task.wait(0.05)
			end
		end
	end

	if os.clock() > Engine.readyAt then
		Engine.readyAt = os.clock()
	end
end

function Engine.runLoop()
	while Engine.running do
		local ok, err = pcall(Engine.step)
		if not ok then
			warnLog("WARN engine error: " .. tostring(err))
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end
end

function Engine.start()
	if Engine.running then
		return
	end
	if not Data.ready then
		warnLog("WARN pack data not ready, autoroll may not buy anything")
	end
	Scanner.refresh()
	Engine.running = true
	Engine.readyAt = os.clock()
	Engine.setStatus("RUNNING")
	task.spawn(Engine.runLoop)
	log("autoroll started")
	if UI then
		UI.onEngineState()
	end
end

function Engine.stop(reason)
	local wasRunning = Engine.running
	Engine.running = false
	Engine.setStatus(reason or "STOPPED")
	if wasRunning then
		log("autoroll stopped" .. (reason and (": " .. reason) or ""))
	end
	if UI then
		UI.onEngineState()
	end
end

function Engine.toggle()
	if Engine.running then
		Engine.stop("STOPPED")
	else
		Engine.start()
	end
end

function Engine.resetStats()
	for key in pairs(Engine.stats) do
		Engine.stats[key] = 0
	end
	if UI then
		UI.updateStats()
	end
end

function Engine.init()
	Engine.running = false
	Engine.setStatus("STOPPED")
	Net.onEvent = Engine.handleEvent

	-- Слежение за сменой плота (респавн / телепорт).
	local plotValue = player:FindFirstChild("PlotNumber")
	if plotValue and plotValue:IsA("ValueBase") then
		track(plotValue.Changed:Connect(function()
			Scanner.refresh()
			if UI then
				UI.refreshAll()
			end
		end))
	end
end

	selectedPack = nil,

	_syncing = false,

local STATUS_TEXT = {

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.1 Словари мутаций (display ↔ raw)
------------------------------------------------------------------

local function rebuildMutationMaps()
	UI.mutLabels = {}
	UI.mutToRaw = {}
	UI.rawToLabel = {}

	for _, mutation in ipairs(Data.mutations) do
		local label = mutation.display
		if UI.mutToRaw[label] then
			-- редкий случай: одинаковые display-имена — показываем сырое имя
			label = mutation.name
		end
		UI.mutLabels[#UI.mutLabels + 1] = label
		UI.mutToRaw[label] = mutation.name
		UI.rawToLabel[mutation.name] = label
	end
end

local function packNames()
	local names = {}
	for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
		names[#names + 1] = pack.id
	end
	return names
end

-- NextUI не любит пустые списки значений — подставляем заглушку.
local function safeValues(list, placeholder)
	if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then
		return { placeholder }
	end
	return list
end

local function allowedLabels(packId)
	local labels = {}
	local entry = Store.readPack(packId)
	if not entry then
		return labels
	end
	for rawName, allowed in pairs(entry.mutations) do
		if allowed == true then
			labels[#labels + 1] = UI.rawToLabel[rawName] or rawName
		end
	end
	table.sort(labels)
	return labels
end

local function writeMutations(packId, labels)
	local entry = Store.packEntry(packId)
	entry.mutations = {}
	for _, label in ipairs(labels or {}) do
		local rawName = UI.mutToRaw[label] or label
		if Data.mutationByName[rawName] then
			entry.mutations[rawName] = true
		end
	end
	Store.save()
end

local function packEntryEnabled(packId)
	local entry = Store.readPack(packId)
	return entry ~= nil and entry.enabled == true
end

local function setPackEnabled(packId, enabled)
	local entry = Store.packEntry(packId)
	entry.enabled = enabled == true
	Store.save()
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.2 Тексты для карточек
------------------------------------------------------------------

local function overviewText()
	if not Data.ready then
		return "Pack data is unavailable. The ConveyorPacks module was not found — "
			.. "open the Packs tab again after you joined a plot, or press \"Reload pack data\"."
	end
	local lines = {}
	for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
		local entry = Store.readPack(pack.id)
		local enabled = entry ~= nil and entry.enabled == true
		local labels = allowedLabels(pack.id)
		local mutationText = "no mutations"
		if #labels > 0 then
			mutationText = table.concat(labels, ", ")
		end
		lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(
			"%s %s — %s",
			enabled and "[ON] " or "[off]",
			pack.id,
			mutationText
		)
	end
	if #lines == 0 then
		lines[1] = "No packs found."
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function statsText()
	local s = Engine.stats
	return string.format(
		"Rolls %d   ·   Seen %d   ·   Bought %d\nSkipped %d   ·   Failed %d",
		s.rolls,
		s.seen,
		s.bought,
		s.skipped,
		s.failed
	)
end

local function plotText()
	local parts = {}
	if Scanner.plotNumber ~= nil then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "Plot " .. tostring(Scanner.plotNumber)
	else
		parts[#parts + 1] = "Plot unknown"
	end
	if Scanner.clickDetector then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "spawn button found"
	else
		parts[#parts + 1] = "spawn button missing"
	end
	if Net.clickMode == "clickdetector" then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "click: clickdetector"
	elseif Net.clickMode == "mouse" then
		parts[#parts + 1] = "click: mouse"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "  ·  ")
end

local function storageText()
	local mode = Store.isFileMode() and ("file: " .. CONFIG.storageFolder .. "/" .. CONFIG.storageFile)
		or "PlayerGui attributes (not saved between rejoins)"
	return string.format(
		"%s\nPacks %d   ·   Mutations %d   ·   Interval %d ms",
		mode,
		#Data.packs,
		#Data.mutations,
		Store.get().timingMs
	)
end

------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8.3 Публичные методы UI (их зовёт движок)
------------------------------------------------------------------

function UI.notify(kind, title, content)
	local nextui = UI.nextui
	if not nextui then
		log(title .. (content and (" — " .. content) or ""))
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		if kind == "good" then
			nextui:Success(title, content)
		elseif kind == "danger" then
			nextui:Error(title, content)
		elseif kind == "warn" then
			nextui:Warning(title, content)
		else
			nextui:Info(title, content)
		end
	end)
end

-- Совместимость со старым кодом движка.
function UI.toast(text, kind)
	UI.notify(kind or "info", "Conveyor Auto", text)
end

function UI.updateStats()
	if not UI.statsLabel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		UI.statsLabel:Set("Counters", statsText())
	end)
end

function UI.setStatus(status)
	UI.status = status
	if UI.statusLabel then
		local text = STATUS_TEXT[status] or tostring(status)
		pcall(function()
			UI.statusLabel:Set("State", text .. "\n" .. plotText())
		end)
	end
	if UI.storageLabel then
		pcall(function()
			UI.storageLabel:Set("Storage", storageText())
		end)
	end
end

-- Держит переключатель Autoroll в синхроне с реальным состоянием движка.
function UI.onEngineState()
	if not UI.autorollToggle or UI._syncing then
		return
	end
	local want = Engine.running == true
	local ok, current = pcall(function()
		return UI.autorollToggle:Get()
	end)
	if not ok or current == want then
		return
	end
	UI._syncing = true
	pcall(function()
		UI.autorollToggle:Set(want)
	end)
	UI._syncing = false
end

function UI.updateLastSeen(info)
	if not UI.lastLabel then
		return
	end
	local packName, mutationName = packLabel(info)
	local price = info and info.price or 0
	pcall(function()
		UI.lastLabel:Set("Last seen", string.format("%s  ·  %s  ·  %s", packName, mutationName, formatPrice(price)))
	end)
end

function UI.refreshOverview()
	if not UI.overviewLabel then
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		UI.overviewLabel:Set("All packs", overviewText())
	end)
end

-- Ставит выбранный пак в дропдаун + его мутации в мультиселект.
function UI.selectPack(packId, skipSync)
	if not Data.packById[packId] then
		for _, pack in ipairs(Data.packs) do
			packId = pack.id
			break
		end
	end
	UI.selectedPack = packId
	if skipSync then
		return
	end
	UI._silent = true
	if UI.packDropdown then
		pcall(function()
			UI.packDropdown:Set(packId)
		end)
	end
	if UI.mutSelect then
		pcall(function()
			UI.mutSelect:Set(allowedLabels(packId))
		end)
	end
	UI._silent = false
end

-- Полное обновление: значения из Store + тексты.
function UI.refreshAll()
	if not UI.window then
		return
	end
	local cfg = Store.get()
	UI._silent = true

	if UI.intervalSlider then
		pcall(function()
			UI.intervalSlider:Set(cfg.timingMs)
		end)
	end
	if UI.jitterSlider then
		pcall(function()
			UI.jitterSlider:Set(cfg.jitterMs)
		end)
	end
	if UI.stopToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.stopToggle:Set(cfg.options.stopOnNoMoney == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.autoToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.autoToggle:Set(cfg.options.autoStart == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.bindListToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.bindListToggle:Set(cfg.options.showBindList == true)
		end)
	end
	if UI.menuKeyBind then
		pcall(function()
			UI.menuKeyBind:Set(keyCodeOf(cfg.keybinds.toggleUI, Enum.KeyCode.RightShift))
		end)
	end
	if UI.autorollToggle then
		pcall(function()
			UI.autorollToggle:Set(Engine.running == true)
		end)
	end
	UI._silent = false

	if UI.packDropdown then
		pcall(function()
			UI.packDropdown:Refresh(safeValues(packNames(), "(packs unavailable)"))
		end)
	end
	if UI.bulkSelect then
		pcall(function()
			UI.bulkSelect:Refresh(safeValues(UI.mutLabels, "(no mutations)"))
		end)
	end
	UI.selectPack(UI.selectedPack)
	UI.refreshOverview()
	UI.updateStats()
	UI.updateStatusOnly()
	UI.setStatus(Engine.status)
end

function UI.updateStatusOnly()
	if not UI.statusLabel then
		return
	end
	local text = STATUS_TEXT[UI.status] or tostring(UI.status)
	pcall(function()
		UI.statusLabel:Set("State", text .. "\n" .. plotText())
	end)
end

-- После "Reset defaults" подтягиваем значения заново.
function UI.afterReset()
	UI.refreshAll()
	UI.notify("warn", "Settings reset", "Defaults restored")
end

-- 9. BOOT — сборка и запуск

function destroy()
	if Engine and Engine.stop then
		Engine.stop("STOPPED")
	end
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
		pcall(function()
			connection:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	connections = {}
	if UI and UI.nextui then
		pcall(function()
			UI.nextui:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	UI.window = nil
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
	if env and env.ConveyorAuto and env.ConveyorAuto.version == VERSION then
		env.ConveyorAuto = nil
	end
	log("destroyed")
end

local function boot()
	log("v" .. VERSION .. " starting… (NextUI)")

	-- Корректно снимаем предыдущий запуск, если он был.
	local env = getgenv and getgenv() or nil
	if env and env.ConveyorAuto and type(env.ConveyorAuto.destroy) == "function" then
		pcall(env.ConveyorAuto.destroy)
	end

	Store.init()
	Scanner.refresh()
	Data.build()
	Engine.init()
	local netOk = Net.init()
	local uiOk = UI.build()

	if uiOk then
		UI.refreshAll()
	end

	log(string.format(
		"loaded · packs=%d · mutations=%d · timing=%dms · storage=%s",
		#Data.packs,
		#Data.mutations,
		Store.get().timingMs,
		Store.isFileMode() and "file" or "attributes"
	))

	if not uiOk then
		warnLog("WARN NextUI failed to load — the script keeps running without a window")
	end
	if not netOk then
		warnLog("WARN ConveyorRE unavailable — auto-buy disabled")
	end
	if not Data.ready then
		warnLog("WARN pack data unavailable — pack list disabled")
	end

	if env then
		env.ConveyorAuto = {
			version = VERSION,
			destroy = destroy,
			engine = Engine,
			data = Data,
			store = Store,
			ui = UI,
			net = Net,
			scanner = Scanner,
		}
	end

	if Store.get().options.autoStart then
		task.delay(1, function()
			if not Engine.running then
				Engine.start()
			end
		end)
	end
end

boot()

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

    keybindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

    end)

            animTrack:Play()
        end
    end)

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1

	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
